messages.text: I’ll independently check the balanced baseline against the approved study inputs, then review the new native reports and TDR claims when they’re pinned. I’ll keep the earlier performance results and the new integration checks distinct.

The environment preflight still flags changed setup fingerprints and unverified DD4hep/Geant4 source availability. I’ll review the pinned source and finished exported evidence without starting native jobs or changing dependencies.

The maintained source matches the approved balanced study geometry, including the full tracker, global pixel attachments and material recipes. The finished native audit also agrees with the generated inventory. I’m waiting for the baseline-aware Gen3 export and final TDR pin to complete the review.

The Gen3 checks confirm matching physical sensor frames, portal topology and frozen calibration semantics. There is one identity detail to retain: 602 ACTS sensitive IDs are reordered within the two added discs. Their digitization payloads remain equivalent, but numeric sensor IDs are not universally identical. The TDR aperture and mass-scope corrections are also now present in the working tree.

I’m using the PDF review workflow for the final TDR check. The source tables match the selected geometry; the remaining step is to inspect the compiled pages for stale dimensions, misleading captions or rendering problems.

The final TDR pages show the corrected aperture and mass scope, updated station tables and matching figures. I found no clipping or missing figures. The retained Geant4 smoke output also matches its hashes and contains three events. I’ll close the review with the ACTS-ID qualification and the limits of the historical performance evidence recorded.

BAL-PhysVal-01 is complete. **No remaining source-equivalence, scientific-claim or TDR blocker was found within the assigned scope.** No files were changed and no native jobs were started.

Reviewed source: `888069bb7c0ec04760ff8ea2288316b6cbf86835`; final evidence/TDR: `b19a12b5e48f16d689087875e98d1a5a01003675`. The selection record exactly matches the balanced variant at approved revision `cfd15cb1c0a195a73a8204400b115a2635a52e2a`.

Actual independent checks:

- Compared **734,367 detector/readout nodes, 9,260,387 attributes and 656,138 material references** against the approved study compact, including global attachments and all strip/pipe trees. Maximum dimension/wrapped-angle difference: **2.28×10⁻¹³**. All **1,168 used material pairs** retain equivalent density and elemental composition.
- Verified unchanged **six readout bit descriptors**, **16 global constants**, and ten factory/include source files.
- Audited the finished native report against its eight execution fingerprints, **687,316 expected entities**, 50 role counts and **46,250 sensitive elements**. Maximum relative material-volume/mass discrepancy: **7.08×10⁻¹³**. Independently reproduced all 27 beam-pipe path checks.
- Compared fresh Gen3 geometry with the study geometry: all **46,250 physical sensor identities, centres, signed axes and bounds**, **120 volumes**, **124 portals**, **250 link subsurfaces** and **54 logical groups** correspond. Maximum floating difference: **1.14×10⁻¹³**.
- Verified all **67 material carriers, 68 roles and 8,552 bins** against fresh portals. Added homogeneous donor2 layers remain at **z=±956.825 mm**, 1 mm beyond the outermost sensor face, with normal X0 **0.03082027/0.03090960**.
- Verified frozen calibration correspondence for **54 geometric and 54 pooled groups**, plus all **46,250 physical-sensor digitization payloads**.

**Required identity qualification:** exactly **602 ACTS sensitive IDs are permuted within the two added layer10 discs**, due to changed source-path ordering. Physical readout IDs and frames are preserved; existing layers’ ACTS IDs remain identical. Current digitization payloads are equivalent under this permutation. This does not establish compatibility with arbitrary future per-sensor payloads.

The TDR aperture/mass-scope finding is resolved in the final source and PDF. Standalone pixel mass is **204,746.757453 g**; integrated clipping affects 152 passive parts and reduces it by **11.243043 g**. The manuscript now distinguishes standalone 27 mm apertures from integrated 28.8 mm apertures and the 1 mm pipe clearance.

I independently checked **1,308 positive-endcap module centres/source IDs**, four barrel populations, all 14 generated table rows, headline inventories, circuits and masses, and ten unchanged strip controls. All **85 evidence/source fingerprints** and **67 TDR source/asset fingerprints** verify.

The compiled review PDF was inspected across all 32 pages through contact sheets, with every pixel page 9–21 and overview pages 6–8 inspected individually. No clipping, missing figures or substantive figure/claim issue was found. PDF SHA256: `867638449a7a39a0d5c0e12f2ace13d48e011f3b3f39a5f7b82d1043164e3655`.
